caption: Our volume discount went live in a few clicks: 10% off from 2 items, 20% off from 4, applied automatically at checkout. The side panel says 1 Free-tier discount is left. The store name is hidden.
The same rule shows up in Shopify's own Discounts list as Active and Automatic, so it is a native Shopify discount. Used is 0 because we did not test it in a cart. The store name is hidden.
The billing page in the app: Free with 2 discount rules, Pro at $9.99 a month with a 7-day trial, and Custom at $99 a month plus $120 an hour to build a rule. The store name is hidden.
Shopify's approval screen for Pro Basic: $9.99 every 30 days after a trial ending 24 Nov, and a payment method is required. We cancelled. The store name is hidden.
The dashboard counts 10 discounts: our 1 rule plus 9 made by other apps on the same store. Auto added codes need an app embed that is still Inactive here. The store name is hidden.
